auto_follow.description: If true, automatically reattach to a new primary after failover or follow event.

auto_registration.description: If true, automatically register this standby node with the cluster on startup.

data_directory.description: Path to the PostgreSQL data directory on this node.

events.description: Custom scripts to execute on specific repmgr events (e.g., post_promote, post_failover).

failover.description: Failover mode: 'automatic' (full automated) or 'manual' (requires manual intervention).

failover_targets.description: Ordered list of standby node IDs and hosts to prefer as failover targets. Lowest node_id has highest priority.

follow_command.description: Shell command to execute when a standby starts following a new primary.

log_facility.description: Syslog facility to use when logging to syslog.

log_file.description: Path to the file where repmgr writes its logs (if syslog not used).

log_level.description: Verbosity level for repmgr logs (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, NOTICE, WARNING, ERROR).

monitoring_interval_secs.description: Interval in seconds between health checks for the cluster.

node_id.description: Unique integer identifier for this node in the cluster (1–999999999).

node_name.description: Human-readable name for this node (must be unique within the cluster).

pg_basebackup_options.description: Extra options passed to pg_basebackup when creating a new standby.

postgresql_parameters.description: Custom PostgreSQL configuration parameters to apply on promotion/follow (e.g., max_connections).

primary_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the primary PostgreSQL server.

primary_port.description: Port number of the primary PostgreSQL server.

promote_command.description: Shell command to execute when promoting a standby to primary.

replication_password.description: Password for the replication user. Recommended to use peer or scram-sha-256 auth in pg_hba.conf.

replication_user.description: PostgreSQL user used for streaming replication.

repmgr_database.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database used by repmgr to store cluster metadata.

repmgr_password.description: Password for the repmgr user. Should be stored securely (e.g., via .pgpass).

repmgr_user.description: PostgreSQL user for repmgr operations (must have replication privileges).

service_start_command.description: Command used to start PostgreSQL on this node (e.g., via pg_ctlcluster or systemctl).

service_status_command.description: Command used to check PostgreSQL status on this node.

service_stop_command.description: Command used to stop PostgreSQL on this node (e.g., via pg_ctlcluster or systemctl).

upstream_node.description: Node ID of the upstream node (for cascading replication). Leave blank for direct primary connection.
